_comment: Protected-paths SSOT for the unified 03:00 batch runner's merge predicate (ADR-0105, meeting 2026-11-12). A PR touching any pattern in protectedPaths is hold-for-human-merge: the runner must never merge it, regardless of gate status. Patterns are gitignore-style globs evaluated from the repository root. L0-only - never propagated to templates/ or scaffolded projects. Consumers: the runner prompt's merge predicate (cited by reference) and human PR review. Machine-readable counterpart of ADR-0105 Decision 2.
note: Decision of record: docs/adr/0105-unified-batch-runner.md (Decision 2, protected paths hold-for-human-merge). Changes to this file are themselves protected and merge only via human review. See also docs/designs/2026-11-12-unified-batch-runner-design.md (AC-3).

outOfRepoProtected.name: automation prompts
outOfRepoProtected.reason: The runner's own prompt surface. Out-of-repo vector documented as preserved dissent S2 (meeting 2026-11-12): prompt self-edits are invisible to every in-repo gate. Detection layer landed via T-20261112-003: prompts.manifest.json carries the expected SHA256 of each authority-bearing prompt and the 06:00 KST prompt-integrity verifier compares the live automation prompts against it daily; the launcher-side pre-fire hash gate remains a platform ask.
